title: A part from before the release keeps its Part Library entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part, part A, that was stocked at the test location before this release was installed and whose number and description nobody has changed since.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • One entry is listed with part A's part number and description.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page lists part A at the test location: the part still points to the entry it had before the release.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 6:

  • Edit Inventory Part shows the same description and part number as the Part Library entry.
